verdict.rationale: The only edge-specific evidence is a glancing reference in Netlify's integrations directory (the Turso listing) to bringing data 'close to your edge functions' and deploying globally. That implies Netlify runs code at the edge, but it is not first-party documentation of the feature. The serverless functions claim does not establish execution on a global edge network close to users. Missing for 10: first-party Edge Functions documentation, details on global PoP distribution and latency, runtime/limits details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my code on a global edge network close to end users

citations.quote: Turso is the Edge database that brings your data close to your edge functions. Develop locally and deploy globally
